6.383 rsInvalidSliderDataSetReferenceField
rsInvalidSliderDataSetReferenceField is a critical error that will occur when LabelData.DataSetName
has a reference to an existing DataSet, but any of the peer elements (such as LabelData.Key and
LabelData.Label) has a reference to a non-existing Field within that DataSet.
